title: Black Madonna
text: Was great to visit Vlack Madonna. Que for the cable car was horrible 2.5 hours.  Please avoid going there on special days like Good Friday. Our guide was very knowledgeable.  But had to cut couple of things because of the cable car delay.
author: KPHari

title: Exquisite tour! Montserrat is a must see!
text: We truly enjoyed our tour of beautiful Montserrat. Katrina was a wonderful tour guide! Her enthusiasm was contagious and she clearly wanted us to have a memorable visit. We learned much and saw amazing sights! We highly recommended this tour with Katrina!
author: Allan_D

title: Because of some delays...
text: Because of some delays with the gondola , we did not get to see the choir. Other than that, it was a great experience.
author: Remington_S

title: Wonderful tour guide and driver.
text: We loved this tour company.  Fay was an amazing tour guide- knowledgeable and nice.   Alejandro was our driver and even though the day was rainy and the roads were less than optimal we felt safe with him- so nice too.  I wholeheartedly recommend this company.  The office is conveniently located across from La Sagrada Familia.  Thank you Fay and Alejandro for a beautiful day.
author: O6365HLthomasn
